overview: Elena is a unique poking/counterpoking character, with an emphasis on powerful whiff punishes to back her up. She gets absurdly good reward out of playing “grounded footsies” Street Fighter is known for, dancing in and out of her effective range and encouraging her opponent to poke back. Once they stick out their feet a little too far forward, Elena pulls them into her offense and takes them straight to the corner. While Elena has several good pokes, she's much more balanced around encouraging an opponent to recklessly extend.

Elena brings with her a whole savannah plain of buttons that could dominate neutral if played well. Her bread and butter button is 5MK, a good poke, target-combo starter, and one of the few pokes in SF6 that's plus. 2MP is a long poke for checking drive rush and counter poking. If the opponent loves walking backwards and turtling, then 2MK, 2HK, and 3HK let Elena run them down. Crouching opponents can be opened up with her long-range 6MK, a quick overhead that leads to a small target combo and a knockdown. Elena is really good at checking opponents behavior, especially with her wide arsenal of target combos that can push her poking reward without using Drive.

Other than checking, she also excels at whiff punishing; being one of the characters that gets absurd reward for landing punish counter heavy buttons. 5HK and 5HP punish counter combos are devastating, crippling an opponent's health bar and dragging them to the corner like a raging elephant. Speaking of corner carry, “Rhino Horn” is a flying kick special move that lunges Elena forward. Almost all of her combos midscreen can end with this move, which gives great corner carry on hit. Outside of that, Elena also has “Scratch Wheel,” an anti-air DP, ”Moon Glide,” a backsway to bait pokes for a big counterhit, and “Spinning Scythe” for damage and decent okizeme.

Most essential to her gameplan is "Lynx Song" or "Roll". This causes Elena to roll along the ground, ducking under fireballs while charging up for a followup. If fully charged, each followup becomes very threatening; either she gets a plus on block meaty, a plus on block overhead, or a launcher. If you sense the opponent is going to retaliate, Elena can halt the roll and go for a bait or throw. Wake up with the wrong option, and Elena's strong punish routes will have your head spinning.

However, this meterless offense comes at a cost- Elena is very dependent on whiff punishes to get her gameplan started. While she has great ways to check the opponent, she lacks a lot of ways to enforce her own offense- her walkspeed is unremarkable when compared to other footsie-heavy characters, her Drive Rush is slow, and lacks fireballs to advance behind. As well, she is very dependent on Lynx Song to enforce her offense, which might he a turnoff to those who want a more traditional offensive kit. To sum it up, Elena is a beautiful and unique character to play. If you love characters that have good pokes, long buttons, and reward you for having rock solid fundamentals, then feel Elena's rhythm for yourself.

pick.title: Giant Attacks
pick.text: Some of the longest range normals in the game to control neutral with ease

pick.title: Unique Mixups
pick.text: Rolling can lead into high commitment but powerful setplay options that often end plus on block

pick.title: Patience
pick.text: Thrives with a slow, footsies style, getting big rewards from poking and whiff punishing

avoid.title: Stand/Crouch Confirms
avoid.text: Many moves that whiff on crouching opponents, forcing you to be mindful of your opponent's state

avoid.title: Poor Throw Loop
avoid.text: Needs to spend Drive gauge to perform throw loops, making her corner game weaker than most other characters

avoid.title: Burnout Victim
avoid.text: One of the unlucky few to have a non-invincible Level 1 Super, making Burnout checkmates more frequent

moves.name: Song of the Grasslands
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Elena; large combo-only hitbox makes it more consistent in juggles; reliable but expensive reversal when in Burnout; very consistent anti-air at mid to long range, but cannot hit cross-up and can whiff under closer jumps; opponents cannot avoid a chip KO by jumping after the Super freeze

moves.name: Song of the Grasslands (CA)
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Elena; large combo-only hitbox makes it more consistent in juggles; reliable but expensive reversal when in Burnout; very consistent anti-air at mid to long range, but cannot hit cross-up and can whiff under closer jumps; opponents cannot avoid a chip KO by jumping after the Super freeze

moves.name: Spinning Scythe
moves.notes: Lynx Whirl Cancels (on Hit/on Block/on PC): ~6LP -3/-12/+1, ~6MP -11/-20/-7, ~6HP -13/-22/-9; first 2 hits force stand (last 2 hits will whiff vs. crouch block); first 2 hits have an extended foot hurtbox that can only hit standing opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); block disadvantage refers to stand(crouch); 2nd hit is cancelable into Lynx Whirl (enhanced Roll) on hit/block (but not whiff); all follow-ups are interruptible on block (even if opponent is in Burnout); Lynx Whirl cancel allows Elena to keep up pressure, but does not naturally combo into the follow-ups; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through first 2 hits (CH combos into ~6MK, PC combos into ~6LK); empty ~6LP Roll is safe on hit and can bait Parry/DI/Reversals; last hit puts opponent into limited juggle state, allowing follow-ups like 236MK, DR~2MP, SA2, canceled SA3, or corner 236LK~623HK

moves.name: Moon Glider
moves.notes: Forces stand; sways back significantly (can avoid attacks); sways on frames 5-23 (max distance of 0.71 on frames 14-16); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; safe option out of Drive Rush that can bait the opponent's button/throw and grants a 5MK combo extension after a whiff punish

moves.name: Moon Glider Follow-up
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable follow-up from safe sway starter; puts opponents into limited juggle state (into SA2/SA3); sets up a safe jump vs. grounded opponents near the corner

moves.name: Moon Glider Follow-up
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable follow-up from safe sway starter; puts opponents into limited juggle state (into SA3)

moves.name: Meteor Volley
moves.notes: Good anti-air with air invuln that fully covers the first 2 hits; cannot be used as an invincible reversal against grounded strikes/throws/projectiles (making it much more dangerous to be in Burnout); cannot hit cross-up; puts opponents into limited juggle state (can combo a 236KK full connect after a grounded hit); extreme block disadvantage allows many characters to set activate installs without sacrificing optimal punish starters

moves.name: Revival Dance
moves.notes: Excellent anti-fireball tool due to its invincibility and forward movement; slow startup makes it risky as a reversal (can be safely meatied by light normals); leaves Elena farther away than the Healing version, but with more advantage for Lynx Song or Drive Rush pressure; generally a poor anti-air but can catch some mid-range neutral jumps or divekick landing recovery; has a large combo-only hitbox that makes it more consistent in juggles; opponents can jump after the Super freeze to avoid a chip KO

moves.name: Revival Dance (Healing)
moves.notes: Sacrifices damage and oki in exchange for healing 100 HP; the healing amount is not affected by damage scaling, making it more useful in a highly scaled combo; Elena builds 1 bar of Drive gauge when healing which also allows Drive regeneration to resume slightly earlier (also applies to Burnout gauge); excellent anti-fireball tool due to its invincibility and forward movement; slow startup makes it risky as a reversal (can be safely meatied by light normals); opponents can jump after the Super freeze to avoid a chip KO

moves.name: Rhino Horn
moves.notes: Farthest distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 23-43f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups like 623HK possible in the corner; 4f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: Lynx Song
moves.notes: Longest total distance (2.21); 16f/1.08 distance before 6LK; 19f/1.35 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Rhino Horn
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 13-35f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible anywhere on the screen; some hits can whiff under high airborne opponents (at certain heights, allows a sideswitch juggle); 6f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: Rhino Horn
moves.notes: Shortest distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 15-34f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible in the corner; 3f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: Lynx Song
moves.notes: Shortest total distance (1.37); 13f/0.72 distance before 6LK; 16f/0.87 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Rhino Horn
moves.notes: Medium distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 19-39f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible in the corner; 4f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: Lynx Song
moves.notes: Medium total distance (1.72); 13f/0.66 distance before 6LK; 18f/0.98 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 5f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Lynx Song
moves.notes: Follow-ups are enhanced like the Lynx Whirl versions after only one spin; total distance is between the MP/HP versions (2.02); 15f/0.93 distance before 6LK; 18f/1.19 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; this version is good for combos, pressuring from neutral, and punishing projectiles due to the faster startup on enhanced follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Mallet Smash
moves.notes: 2 hits (if 1st hit is blocked, 2nd hit is no longer an overhead); Low Crush 5-22f (can avoid moves before becoming airborne); projectile invuln disappears for a brief period after Lynx Song/Whirl (less effective as a fireball counter); projectile invuln does not apply to the top of Elena's head; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; overhead that gives strong follow-up pressure on block, a 2LP on hit, and a medium combo after baiting the opponent's low buttons or throw tech; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state on hit (can always pick up a juggle, but exact route depends on height and distance)

moves.name: Leopard Snap
moves.notes: Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox and projectile invuln from Lynx Song (hard to use vs. projectiles); strong ender from Spinning Scythe on hit (3f gap) to reset pressure (but does not frame trap on block); useful for pressure on block (can beat 4f normals with 2LP, catch back walk with 2LK~2LP, and throw except vs. midscreen back walk); 1f extra recovery on whiff; the version used from OD Lynx Song is not considered an OD move for cancel purposes (no SA2 cancel); puts the opponent into a limited juggle state

moves.name: Harvest Circle
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on block/whiff; 1st hit pulls opponents inward on hit/block for combo consistency; extended kicking foot hurtbox is anti-air invuln while active on frames 8-10 (can anti-air opponents jumping out of roll pressure, but cannot hit cross-up); maintains projectile invuln from Lynx Song/Whirl to counter fireballs more effectively; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; can combo from Spinning Scythe ~ Lynx Whirl on Counter-hit/Punish Counter; puts opponent into a limited juggle state

moves.name: Lynx Whirl
moves.notes: Nearly identical to meterless versions except that the cancel window into follow-up specials is extended 3f longer; accessible from a previous OD Lynx Song; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-24f ~6LK, 18-24f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-24f ~6P); total roll distance: 2.59; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Mallet Smash
moves.notes: Low Crush 14-24f (final active frame is considered standing but still has a high hurtbox); projectile invuln disappears for a brief period after Lynx Song (less effective as a fireball counter); projectile invuln does not apply to the top of Elena's head; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; safe overhead that can lead to a 5MK combo after baiting the opponent's throw tech; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state on hit (can always pick up corner juggles, but midscreen juggles depend on height/spacing); total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 16+22, MP 18+22, HP 19+22, OD 18+22)

moves.name: Lynx Whirl
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 2.46; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Leopard Snap
moves.notes: Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox and projectile invuln from Lynx Song (hard to use vs. projectiles); generally safe on block if spaced as a poke; punishable by most characters at closer ranges (notable exceptions: A.K.I. only gets 2LK, Mai gets nothing); combos when buffered from 2MP or 2MK~HK in neutral; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (only into SA3 cancel except in high corner juggles); total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 13+10, MP 13+10, HP 16+10, OD 15+10)

moves.name: Lynx Whirl
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 1.43; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration; safest version of empty Roll to cancel into (e.g. Spinning Scythe ~ empty Lynx Whirl to bait DI/Parry/reversal)

moves.name: Harvest Circle
moves.notes: Extended kicking foot hurtbox is anti-air invuln while active on frames 8-10 (can anti-air opponents jumping out of roll pressure, but cannot hit cross-up); maintains projectile invuln from Lynx Song to counter fireballs more effectively; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 16+8, MP 18+8, HP 19+8, OD 18+8); puts opponent into a limited juggle state

moves.name: Lynx Whirl
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 1.94; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: Root Breaker
moves.notes: Long range sweep; has juggle potential; punishable by most other sweeps even at max range

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: 2 hits; Upper Body/Legs are anti-air invuln on frames 8-19 (solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up); causes air reset vs. airborne opponents; anti-airing with the first hit results in very little frame advantage as the 2nd hit continues to whiff; forces stand (important for 236K combo routes); cancel only comes out on the 2nd hit (will cancel on whiff if the first hit connects on airborne opponent); anti-air cancel into Lynx Song allows Elena to threaten with a meaty roll follow-up or feint to bait Parry (timing/advantage varies heavily based on anti-air timing); high pushback on hit; follow-up links require a Counter-hit, Punish Counter, Drive Rush starter into a ranged button; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits; if 1st hit is Perfect Parried, opponent can interrupt 2nd hit with 5f or faster attack

moves.name: Crouching Light Kick
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK

moves.name: Crouching Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-6 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff/block; good combo starter out of Drive Rush but leaves Elena neutral if blocked; can combo naturally into 2LP, but Elena is always punishable by the opponent's 4f normal at this range

moves.name: Fluttering Lark
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 2MK combo starter; whiffs on crouching opponents (-18 after 2MK on hit, -24 after 2MK on block); 4f extra recovery on whiff or parry; the HK itself usually cannot be blocked since a blocked 2MK forces the opponent to crouch under it, but the entire sequence can be parried (block data notated with * refers to this scenario); if the TC is delayed as late as possible, the opponent can block 2MK and then Parry the follow-up or get hit while trying to jump; Special/DI/DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch
moves.notes: Great cancelable poke in neutral; not an anti-air despite the animation; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: Down Taunt
moves.notes: "What's up?"

moves.name: Slide
moves.notes: 4f extra recovery on whiff or vs. armor; does not low profile under projectiles; reaches ~1/2 screen and is safe when spaced well

moves.name: Round Arch
moves.notes: Low Crush 9-17f (not airborne); 2f extra recovery on whiff; Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can chase with DR oki, 236LP~6LP~6LK pressure, or juggle 623MK/623KK if used point blank in the corner); Elena moves backward starting on frame 5 (can help avoid the opponent's attack or throw)

moves.name: Leg Lift Throw
moves.notes: Side switches; no true throw oki even with Drive Rush (except frame-perfect DR~Throw vs. Zangief); in the corner, allows an auto-timed meaty DR~5MK that is +12 oH / +8 oB; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Back Taunt
moves.notes: "And up!"; can hold forward or back to transition into a hand-walking animation on frames 181-370

moves.name: Back Taunt ~ Back Walk
moves.notes: "Hehe, over here!"; cannot change walk animation once it has begun; total animation time depends on when Back was input during the initial Back Taunt

moves.name: Back Taunt ~ Forward Walk
moves.notes: "Cool right? Give it a try!"; cannot change walk animation once it has begun; total animation time depends on when Forward was input during the initial Back Taunt

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Low Crush 9-17f (not airborne); good mid-range poke; Punish Counter puts opponent into limited juggle state (combos reliably into 236KK or SA2 unless whiff punishing a ranged attack); also causes limited juggle state on airborne Counter-hit (into 623HK at close range) and Punish Counter (slightly better juggles than grounded PC); extends hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; hitbox does not move forward during the active frames (cannot be spaced in neutral for better advantage)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Forces stand; foot hitbox cannot hit crouching opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); Punish Counter puts opponent into limited juggle state; strong anti-air hitbox at longer ranges but cannot hit cross-up; extends hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: Turning Tail
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouch blocking opponents; puts opponents into limited juggle state with a much more rewarding juggle after Punish Counter 5HP; if 5HP is stand blocked, the first hit of the follow-up will also be stand blocked, but the last hit still whiffs leaving Elena unsafe; starter scaling only applies if the 2nd HP begins the combo (e.g. opponent tries to jump out after crouch blocking 5HP)

moves.name: Standing Light Kick
moves.notes: Ranged light poke that gives Elena strong punishes and confirms; allows for 4-light confirm strings after chained 2LPs, but does not combo naturally into 214LK; Special/DI cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame; DR cancel is delayed until after 3rd active frame

moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: Good range for a light normal; less range than 5LK, but leads to better 5f punish combos; DR cancel is delayed until after 3rd active frame

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; useful combo and frame trap tool; short range for a 6-frame medium

moves.name: Hind Kick
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; Elena's main Target Combo conversion on crouching opponents; Special/DI/DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame

moves.name: Standing Medium Punch
moves.notes: Strong neutral buffer tool; active frames 1-2 have shorter range (this close-range hitbox disappears after the 3rd active frame, making it less useful as a meaty); active frames 3-5 gain a longer range foot hitbox, but cannot hit crouching opponents and cannot hit cross-up; these later active frames result in 2f better frame advantage; the final 2 TC cancel frames do not combo without at least a Counter-hit starter; lenient hitconfirm window gives time to confirm a Super, or a TC follow-up if the opponent is standing; forces stand on Punish Counter, ensuring the TC will fully connect

moves.name: Starling Beak
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents (but can force stand with Punish Counter 5MP); interruptible 6-8f gap between hits; does not combo from the final 2 cancelable frames of 5MP without at least a Counter-hit

moves.name: Neutral Taunt
moves.notes: "It's such a lovely day. And I hope you're having a good one too!"

moves.name: Scratch Wheel
moves.notes: Strong mid-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; has the most range for grounded juggles and cancels; connecting with active frames 3-4 makes the first hit whiff (500 less damage), and active frames 5-6 make the first 2 hits whiff (900 less damage), making early anti-air attempts weaker

moves.name: Scratch Wheel
moves.notes: Elena's primary reversal; cannot hit cross-up; connecting with active frames 5-6 makes the first hit whiff (450 less damage), making early anti-air attempts weaker

moves.name: Scratch Wheel
moves.notes: Strong close-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; can launch high airborne opponent high enough for a follow-up Scratch Wheel juggle (incurs starter scaling)

moves.name: Scratch Wheel
moves.notes: Strong close/mid-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; active frames 4-6 will only deal 1 hit for half damage, making early anti-air attempts weaker; can only incur starter scaling if trading with a grounded normal and landing a follow-up juggle

moves.name: Trunk Slap 1
moves.notes: Forward-moving ranged poke that can be hitconfirmed into a TC knockdown follow-up; TC is always a true blockstring; pushback keeps Elena safe (except at close range vs. Marisa/E.Honda/Sagat 2LP and Zangief 2LK); pushback also prevents a follow-up link even with Drive Rush (+5), but can link 5LK after a corner Punish Counter

moves.name: Boar Charge (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Boar Charge (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Trunk Slap 2
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable extension from long-range 6HP; has no juggle potential (will not juggle after DI wall splat); always a true blockstring from 6HP

moves.name: Trunk Slap 3
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage after a 6HP combo starter; good corner carry and knockdown advantage that can lead to auto-timed Lynx Whirl pressure on the opponent's wakeup; always a true blockstring from 6HP~HP

moves.name: Handstand Whip 1
moves.notes: Long-range overhead with fast startup and a hitconfirmable TC follow-up

moves.name: Handstand Whip 2
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable Target Combo that makes Elena's long-range overhead more threatening even without Drive Rush

moves.name: Forward Taunt
moves.notes: "One, two, and spin! What do you say? How about you dance with me!"; overrides the current background music with the Reniala Remains stage theme with increased volume

moves.name: Giraffe Neck
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: 2 hits; 1st hit puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; 2nd hit causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 2nd hit has the most horizontal range of Elena's air normals; overall weaker as an air approach due to the damage being split between 2 hits (very specific timing required to land both hits vs. grounded opponents); if 1st hit is stand blocked, the 2nd hit will not hit overhead against crouch block; lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Elena's strongest overall jump-in (reaches downward faster than j.HK and deals all its damage in one hit); lower body projectile invuln 10-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead; good downward hitbox priority (likely to beat or trade with anti-airs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Punch
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead (except vs. Blanka); Target Combo extension can lead to better advantage vs. grounded opponents, giving more time to hitconfirm a follow-up

moves.name: Soaring Raid
moves.notes: Can hit after cross-up j.LP; can be done from any jump direction; does not work as an air-to-air even after a Forced Knockdown; will not connect if the j.LP hits a crouching opponent

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up with a wide hitbox in both directions; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; at most air-to-air timings, Elena's only follow-up juggle is a Target Combo extension; whiffs against standard-sized crouching opponents; lower body projectile invuln 8-17f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Raptor Range
moves.notes: Knockdown ender from air-to-air j.MP that puts opponent into a limited juggle state; can be done from any jump direction; cannot connect on a grounded opponent

moves.name: Leg Tackle
moves.notes: Grants a frame-perfect throw loop against Zangief (Dash + walk 2f); allows a frame-perfect corner throw loop with Drive Rush (more lenient vs. Marisa/Blanka/E.Honda/Zangief); throw pressure is more effective when mixed with other DR buttons, or feints like DR~214P); can also Dash + 5MK for weak pressure and a link to 5LK on hit; Lynx Song can be used for mixups (LP Roll into 6LK/6MK to beat reversal buttons, OD Roll into 6HK to beat throws, empty LP Roll to bait Perfect Parry at only -4 on whiff); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.548 (min/throw), 2.100 (min/block), 3.011 (max/final DR frame)

patches.summary: Ingrid Release. Minor system changes and bug fixes.
notes: Fixed issue where 2nd attack would not be performed while holding the Assist button

patches.summary: Alex Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: HK Rhino Horn (236HK) launches opponent higher; KD +39 → KD +40
Allows corner juggle into HK Scratch Wheel and better midscreen oki (KD +2 after HP Roll)
SA1 launches opponent higher; KD +42 → KD +44; can now juggle OD Rhino Horn off a grounded hit
SA2 (Healing) health recovery increased 1300 → 1600; now recovers 10000 Drive gauge (1 bar)

patches.summary: Bug fixes and minor adjustments, primarily for Elena, Mai, and Sagat.
notes: Boosted Leopard Snap (236P~6P~6LK or 236PP~6LK) pushback on block reduced, and normalized the distance on block when used midscreen or in the corner
1st hit has less blowback on airborne opponents to make the 2nd hit more consistent in juggles
Moon Glider (214P~6P) 2nd attack hitbox expanded forward
OD Moon Glider (214PP) pushback on hit reduced, increased forward movement after the backwards sway
More effective as a shimmy tool, leading to more consistent Punish Counter follow-ups
SA1 startup reduced 9f → 7f; total animation 96f → 94f; can now build Super gauge after landing this in a combo
All airborne and air invuln frames shifted 2f earlier to compensate

patches.summary: C. Viper Release. Minor bug fixes and adjustments for some characters.
notes: Moon Glider (214P/PP~6P) hitstop on block increased 11 → 13 to match the on-hit version
This prevents an option select where follow-ups could be performed only on hit, bypassing the need to hitconfirm it

patches.summary: Sagat Release. Minor bug fixes and adjustments (mostly related to Tiger Shot interactions).
notes: Round Arch (4HK) fixed an issue where Elena would slide forward when performed out of Drive Rush when not inputting a direction
Critical Art (214214K) fixed an issue where the damage value was increased by 1000 when landing a K.O. against the opponent
